description: Export an owned saved workflow or a supplied valid spec without generation credits. Returns a file resource, not an embedded app. Use explicit export only when requested; normal conversational compilation returns Mermaid for the host to render. PDF remains vector. Requires workflow:read.

authToken.description: Optional existing session token for non-OAuth transports.

id.description: ID of a saved workflow owned by the current account.

layoutOverrides.description: Existing canvas positions/sizes keyed by node ID; coordinates and sizes must be finite and bounded. Not encoded in Mermaid.

orientation.description: Mermaid emits TD for portrait or LR for landscape; choose uses existing auto-orientation. Final geometry depends on the host renderer.

spec.description: A source-cited VisualSpec v0.1. Preserve original excerpts and attribution.

style.description: Unseen-rendered style; Mermaid appearance is controlled by the chatbot's renderer.

viewMode.description: Unseen-rendered layout. Snake wrapping and swimlane geometry are not encoded in Mermaid.

name: export_workflow
title: Export Workflow File
